svg.title: Yamaha CK76 labelled interface
svg.desc: Original schematic of selected controls, grouped by function. Positions are illustrative, not scaled hardware dimensions; connections.svg is a separate socket inventory. No MIDI assignments are implied.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.
